notes: Visualizer: Zen mode (full-screen takeover). New corner-brackets button on the Sound widget expands the visualizer to fill the whole new tab — hides menu bar, dock, other widgets, and wallpaper. Floating glass controls fade out after 2s of mouse idle (cursor hides too); move the mouse to bring them back. Esc exits at any time.
